reviewer_provenance.model_configuration: Codex GPT-5 offline review; no provider, API, or model call was made
reviewer_provenance.limitation: This is an independent source-and-gold adjudication by one internal reviewer, not a human expert review and not a model-independent external review.

label_definitions.EXACT_GOLD_PARTICIPANT: The candidate target kind, exact text, source entity type, and source offsets equal a public-gold argument target.
label_definitions.SOURCE_SUPPORTED_EQUIVALENT: The source supports the same participant or event reference as a scientifically meaningful equivalent, but it is outside the exact public-gold participant representation or belongs to a non-gold contextual event.
label_definitions.WRONG_PARTICIPANT: The predicted target is not the participant target required for this event, including a contextual participant attached to the wrong event level.
label_definitions.WRONG_ENTITY_TYPE: The prediction treats a source mention with the wrong target kind or semantic entity/event kind for the requested participant slot.
label_definitions.MISSING_PRIMARY_PARTICIPANT: A required primary gold participant or nested event is absent from the candidate event; this label is used only when the judgment directly identifies that omission.
label_definitions.EXTRA_UNSUPPORTED_PARTICIPANT: The prediction adds a participant or event reference not supported as that target by the source and annotation contract.
label_definitions.OFFSET_MISMATCH: The predicted offsets do not resolve exactly to the returned participant text or to the gold span.
label_definitions.OUTSIDE_EVENT_SCOPE: The predicted offsets are outside the supplied atomic event passage.
label_definitions.AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE: The prediction cannot be uniquely tied to one source occurrence or event reference from the supplied passage.
label_definitions.OCCURRENCE_IDENTITY_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: The occurrence identifier does not identify the corresponding exact-text occurrence under the supplied event-local occurrence map.
